records.title: Exploring the Roles of Large Language Models in Reshaping Transportation Systems: A Survey, Framework, and Roadmap
records.reason: Survey concerns LLM application roles in transportation systems, not inference/serving efficiency. Primary abstract: Modern transportation systems face pressing challenges due to increasing demand, dynamic environments, and heterogeneous information integration. The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers transformative potential to address these challenges.
